# MESA — Multidisciplinary Environment for Scientific Advancement

> MESA is an open-source, agentic AI platform that connects scientific data through curated, indexed metadata — a data lakehouse, a federated data mesh, and AI agents that speak both. NSF IDSS Category II project at the University of New Mexico. This origin is published for people and for AI agents: its content is an Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) bundle whose documents carry YAML frontmatter with type, provenance (generated/sources), trust (verified), and lifecycle (status/stale_after) fields.

Full corpus for ingestion: https://idss-mesa.github.io/llms-full.txt

Links below point at each document's Markdown, OKF frontmatter included; every rendered page declares the same twin with <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"> in its <head>. OKF bundle root: https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/index.md. Agent guide: https://idss-mesa.github.io/about/ai-agents/

MESA's software is a set of MCP servers: for scientific data, connect to them (the agent guide explains how) rather than scraping these pages.

## Site

- [MESA — Multidisciplinary Environment for Scientific Advancement](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/home.md): MESA is an open-source, agentic AI platform that connects scientific data through curated, indexed metadata — a data lakehouse, a federated data mesh, and AI agents that speak both. NSF IDSS Category II project at the University of New Mexico. Canonical: https://idss-mesa.github.io/
- [MESA Hiring](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/hiring.md): MESA and CARC are hiring at the University of New Mexico — full-time positions at the Center for Advanced Research Computing in Albuquerque. Canonical: https://idss-mesa.github.io/hiring.html
- [For AI agents](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/ai-agents.md): How agents and harnesses should read idss-mesa.github.io — robots.txt, llms.txt, Markdown twins with OKF v0.2 frontmatter, and trust signals — and why to call the MESA MCP servers for data. Canonical: https://idss-mesa.github.io/about/ai-agents/

## Documentation

- [MESA MCP Stack Documentation](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/docs.md): One-line install of the CyVerse MESA MCP stack (mesa-mcp, mesa-ducklake, irods-mcp-server, formation-mcp) for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity, and OpenCode. Canonical: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/

## Software

- [mesa-mcp](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/mesa-mcp.md): MCP server bridging the CyVerse Data Store (iRODS) with OBO/OLS ontology AVU tools, DataCite metadata, and DuckLake metadata history. Canonical: https://github.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp
- [mesa-ducklake](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/mesa-ducklake.md): AVU metadata-history library for MESA projects (DuckLake: Postgres/DuckDB catalog plus Parquet in iRODS). Canonical: https://github.com/idss-mesa/mesa-ducklake
- [irods-mcp-server](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/irods-mcp-server.md): Reference MCP server for the CyVerse Data Store (iRODS), written in Go. Canonical: https://github.com/idss-mesa/irods-mcp-server
- [formation-mcp](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/formation-mcp.md): MCP server for the CyVerse Discovery Environment (Formation API): launch apps and manage analyses, written in Go. Canonical: https://github.com/idss-mesa/formation-mcp
- [neon-mcp](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/neon-mcp.md): MCP (2026-07-28) server for the NEON Data API: discover, check availability, list, download and cite NEON ecological data. Canonical: https://github.com/idss-mesa/neon-mcp
- [mesa-sandbox](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/mesa-sandbox.md): AI sandboxes for CyVerse VICE: a sudo-free multi-arch image family, sandbox profiles P0–P4, an OpenBao credential broker and egress proxy, and agent-sandbox pods for autonomous agents. Canonical: https://github.com/idss-mesa/mesa-sandbox
- [MESA CLI](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/cli.md): CyVerse Cloud Shell CLI with MESA tools. Canonical: https://github.com/idss-mesa/cli
- [mesa-portal](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/mesa-portal.md): Portal based on the CyVerse Terrain API. Canonical: https://github.com/idss-mesa/mesa-portal (private repository; not publicly readable)
- [mesa-forge](https://idss-mesa.github.io/okf/concepts/mesa-forge.md): A metadata extraction tool generation and management library. Canonical: https://github.com/idss-mesa/mesa-forge (private repository; not publicly readable)

## Sub-site bundles

- [MESA MCP stack docs: llms.txt](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/llms.txt): outline of one-line install of the CyVerse MESA MCP stack for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity, and OpenCode
- [MESA MCP stack docs: llms-full.txt](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/llms-full.txt): every page's Markdown with OKF frontmatter in one file
- [MESA MCP stack docs: agent guide](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/about/ai-agents/): endpoints and trust signals; any page URL + index.md returns that page's Markdown
- [neon-mcp docs: llms.txt](https://idss-mesa.github.io/neon-mcp/llms.txt): outline of the MCP server for the NEON Data API: install, API token, tool catalogue, and deployment
- [neon-mcp docs: llms-full.txt](https://idss-mesa.github.io/neon-mcp/llms-full.txt): every page's Markdown with OKF frontmatter in one file
- [neon-mcp docs: agent guide](https://idss-mesa.github.io/neon-mcp/about/ai-agents/): endpoints and trust signals; any page URL + index.md returns that page's Markdown
